name: foxpro-linter
description: Diagnostics for Visual FoxPro: a real grammar, and rules that stay quiet unless there is evidence
author: Sean Kaat

foxpro.maxNumberOfProblems.description: Maximum number of problems reported per file.

enumDescriptions: Do not report unsupported syntax at all.
foxpro.unsupportedSyntaxSeverity.markdownDescription: How to report statements the linter cannot parse yet. These are usually valid FoxPro the grammar has not learned rather than mistakes in your code, so they are advisory by default. Genuine syntax errors are always reported as errors, whatever this is set to.
foxpro.unsupportedSyntaxSeverity.markdownDeprecationMessage: Use `#foxpro.rules#` instead, which sets the severity of every rule, `unsupported-syntax` included.

foxpro.rules.markdownDescription: The severity of each rule, or `off` to disable it. A rule not listed here keeps its default. `syntax-error` and `unterminated-block` are always errors and cannot be set. Any diagnostic can also be silenced in place with a comment: `* vfp-lint-disable-next-line implicit-private`.

unsupported-syntax.description: Valid FoxPro the grammar has not learned yet.

implicit-private.description: An assignment to an undeclared name, which FoxPro creates as a PRIVATE.

unused-local.description: A LOCAL that is never read or written.

missing-memvar-prefix.description: A variable referenced without m. whose name is also used as a field.

unreachable-code.description: A statement after RETURN, EXIT or LOOP in the same block.

duplicate-case.description: A CASE condition identical to an earlier one in the same DO CASE.

private-all.description: PRIVATE ALL, which hides every variable of the caller.

unclosed-transaction.description: A BEGIN TRANSACTION the routine leaves without closing.

unlinked-tables.description: Tables in FROM with nothing relating them: a Cartesian product.

select-without-into.description: A query with no INTO or TO, which browses its whole result.

having-without-group-by.description: HAVING with no GROUP BY, so it is only a post-filter.

try-without-catch.description: A TRY with neither CATCH nor FINALLY.

empty-branch.description: An IF, ELSE, CASE or OTHERWISE branch with no statements.

foxpro.trace.server.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and the FoxPro language server.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: bun run build:parser && bun run typecheck && bun run bundle:production
scripts.compile: bun run build:parser && bun run typecheck && bun run bundle
scripts.dev: concurrently -n parser,bundle,tsc-client,tsc-server,tsc-test "bun run watch:parser" "bun run watch:bundle" "tsc -p client/tsconfig.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "tsc -p server/tsconfig.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "tsc -p test/tsconfig.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p client/tsconfig.json && tsc -p server/tsconfig.json && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: bun ./test/run-all-tests.ts && bun ./test/run-ast-tests.ts && bun ./test/run-parse-tests.ts && bun ./test/run-scope-tests.ts && bun ./test/run-severity-tests.ts && bun ./test/run-keyword-tests.ts && bun ./test/run-fix-tests.ts
scripts.e2e: bun run compile && node ./scripts/build.mjs --tests && node client/out/test/runTest.js
